turns.doctor_question: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
turns.patient_response: Hi. Thank you. Well, what brings me in today is just this constant restless feeling I've been having. It’s like I’m wound too tight and I just can’t fully settle down. It happens even when I’m supposed to be completely calm—like if I'm sitting through a long planning meeting for work, or even during my own time when I'm painting or trying to do yoga. I just can't seem to shake it.

turns.doctor_question: Do you find yourself fidgeting or having an urge to move parts of your body when you're feeling this restlessness?

I actually do it so much that I often have to put myself on mute so they don't hear the pen clicking, or I have to consciously move my hands out of view of the camera. It's just a constant urge to be doing something with my hands or feet.
